name: Jif Creamy Smooth Peanut Butter (2 Tbsp)
whyItWorks: While whole peanuts are dangerous stricture hazards, commercial creamy peanut butter is micro-milled into a velvety emulsion. It provides calorie-dense fats, protein, and vitamin E without any jagged particles to scrape intestinal walls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread a thin layer (1–2 tablespoons) onto white toast, saltines, or rice cakes. Avoid eating heaping thick spoonfuls at once to prevent esophageal sticking.
watchOuts: Must be 100% smooth/creamy; never purchase crunchy varieties.
